[USER] User is trying to get their medical bills organized.  
[USER] User wants help setting up a spreadsheet to track all doctor's appointments and expenses.  
[USER] User saw their primary care physician on February 27th, which started the whole process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help set up a spreadsheet to track medical bills and appointments.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a suggested template for a Medical Appointment and Expense Tracker with three worksheets: Appointments, Expenses, and Insurance and Payments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant detailed how to use the Appointments worksheet to track each doctor's appointment, including date, doctor/provider, reason for visit, diagnosis, and follow-up appointments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained how to use the Expenses worksheet to track each medical expense, including date, provider, service/procedure, charge, insurance payment, balance due, and payment status.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described how to use the Insurance and Payments worksheet to track insurance information, including insurance company, policy number, claim number, date filed, date paid, and amount paid.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for filling in the spreadsheet and encouraged regular updates to ensure nothing is missed.  
[USER] User requested to add a column to the Appointments worksheet to track prescriptions given.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant agreed and updated the Appointments worksheet to include a "Prescriptions" column.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested details to include in the Prescriptions column, such as medication name, dosage, frequency, number of refills, refill date, and pharmacy information.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided an example of the updated Appointments worksheet with the new "Prescriptions" column.  
[USER] User requested to add a column to the Expenses worksheet to track copays and deductibles for each appointment and procedure.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant agreed and updated the Expenses worksheet to include "Copay/Deductible" and "Total Out-of-Pocket" columns.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided an example of the updated Expenses worksheet with the new columns.
